Live: Democrats wrest control of Senate from Republicans in midterm upsetUS Midterm Election 2026 Live Updates: The US midterm elections have dealt a major blow to President Donald Trump and the Republican Party, with Democrats reclaiming control of the Senate and winning a majority in the House of Representatives, giving them unified control of Congress. The Democratic surge has extended into traditionally Republican strongholds, with almost a dozen House seats flipping to the party. Texas, Kansas and South Carolina have also elected Democratic senators for the first time in decades. Democrats have made significant gains in gubernatorial races as well, with Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia, Amy Acton in Ohio, Rob Sand in Iowa and Gina Hinojosa in Texas defeating Republican rivals to capture GOP-held governorships. The results mark a major setback for Trump and are being viewed as a verdict on his leadership, his administration's policies and its handling of the fallout from the Iran war, which has added to economic and political pressures, particularly through its impact on global energy markets. Stay tuned with us for the latest updates, including ground reports from our reporter Rohit Sharma and developments from major US media outlets.
